description: This file defines the KeyboardSupport class, providing utility methods for handling keyboard key codes, drawable bounds, key height calculations, and retrieving keyboard height factors based on device orientation and user preferences within the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: KeyboardSupport
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for handling keyboard key codes, drawable bounds, key height calculations, and retrieving keyboard height factors based on device orientation and user preferences.

methods.name: parseCSV
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key codes into an integer array, handling both numeric and character representations.

methods.name: updateDrawableBounds
methods.description: Sets the bounds of a Drawable object to its intrinsic width and height.

methods.name: getKeyCodesFromTypedArray
methods.description: Extracts key codes from a TypedArray at a specified index, parsing CSV strings or reading integer values.

methods.name: getKeyHeightFromHeightCode
methods.description: Calculates the key height based on a height code and a height factor, considering predefined height categories.

methods.name: getKeyboardHeightFactor
methods.description: Returns an Observable that emits the keyboard height factor (as a float) based on device orientation and user preferences.
